maria: Heads-up — external security assessment is booked for Tue 09:00 PST. We need to coordinate: RBAC freeze window, KMS evidence export, audit log bundle, vuln triage process, and a retest timeline. Who can own each?

khalid: I'll own the RBAC freeze + rollback playbook. Suggest freeze window: 08:30–12:30 PST. Need service list and role owners.

alex: I can handle KMS exports and key metadata. Important: we will NOT include plaintext keys. We'll export key usage logs, rotation history, and key policy snapshots :eyes:

jordan: I'll take audit logs. Plan: CloudTrail 30d + SIEM parsable export. Quick sample command I'll run:
```
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --start-time 2025-05-01T00:00:00Z --end-time 2025-05-31T23:59:59Z --query 'Events[]'
```
Also will include an extracted events.csv for the assessment team.

sre-bot: Reminder — Calendar invite sent to #eng-security, #eng-sre, and assessors@vendor.com for Tue 09:00 PST.

sam-ops: For retest, propose 48–72h after fixes are confirmed. Recommend 2hr dry-run slot 24h before retest to validate evidence and ephemeral creds snapshot. I'll prep a runbook for credential snapshots.

khalid: Rollback hook: we have `./scripts/restore_roles.sh` and IaC snapshots. I'll open a PR with the freeze plan and add manual approval step for rollbacks.

maria: Evidence upload — prefer presigned S3 with limited TTL (48h) and bucket-level logging. We also need to record the upload checksums and map them to the ticket.

alex: Agreed. Also: do not bundle KMS material that exposes key metadata linked to user emails. Strip PII. We'll provide key ARNs, rotation timestamps, and CloudTrail KMS events only.

jordan: I'll redact any user identifiers in the SIEM export. We'll include a mapping table for anonymized IDs in case assessors need follow-up.

maria: Tasks + owners (quick):
- RBAC freeze & rollback: khalid
- KMS evidence export: alex
- Audit logs & SIEM export: jordan
- Retest scheduling & runbook: sam-ops
- Evidence upload + retention: maria

maria: Can everyone confirm ETA? Prefer all evidence in the evidence bucket by Mon 17:00 PST so we can do a dry-run Mon 20:00 PST.

khalid: ETA EOD today for freeze plan PR.

alex: KMS exports will be ready by Mon 12:00 PST.

jordan: Logs export ready by Mon 14:00 PST.

sam-ops: Retest runbook draft by Mon 16:00 PST.

maria: Great — I'll create the evidence ticket and ping assessors once uploads are done. Flagging: reviewers should not have write access to evidence bucket.

sre-bot: Action items created: #12345 (RBAC freeze PR), #12346 (KMS export), #12347 (Logs export), #12348 (Retest runbook).

maria: Thanks team. We'll meet briefly Mon 18:30 PST to validate the dry-run checklist. :thumbsup:
